blocks.title: Therapeutic index
blocks.text: Therapeutic index (TI) dawa ki safety (hifazat) ki quantitative measurement (number se naap) hai.

Yeh toxic effect (zehreela asar) dene wali dose ko us dose se compare karta hai jo desired therapeutic effect (chaha gaya ilaaj wala asar) deti hai. Zyada TI ka matlab hai dawa zyada mehfooz hai, kyunke faida dene wali dose aur zehreeli dose mein faasla zyada hai. Kam TI ka matlab hai dawa zyada khatarnak hai aur toxicity (zehreela asar) se bachne ke liye is ki careful monitoring (dhyan se nigrani) karni parti hai.

blocks.alt: Graph: % age of patients responding aur exposure. Neeli Efficacy S-curve ED50 par barhti aur gulabi Toxicity S-curve baad mein TD50 par; dashed khari lakeerein ED50 aur TD50 par. ED50 ke gird hari patti, oopar doharay teer ke saath, Therapeutic window. Neeche daen: Therapeutic index = TD50 / ED50.
blocks.caption: Figure 32.1: Therapeutic window aur therapeutic index (kitab ki Figure 32.1 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neeli curve batati hai ke kitne percent mareezon ko dawa se faida hua (efficacy); gulabi curve batati hai ke kitne percent mein zehreela asar aaya (toxicity). Dono curves ke beech jitna faasla ho, dawa utni mehfooz hai. Hari patti therapeutic window hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 32.1 mein “Therapeutic index = ED₅₀/TD₅₀” chhapa hai, jo ulta hai. Kitab ka apna text kehta hai ke TI zehreeli dose ko faida dene wali dose se compare karta hai, is liye sahi formula TI = TD₅₀ / ED₅₀ hai. Hamari drawing mein yahi sahi formula hai.

blocks.title: Td₅₀ (Toxic Dose 50)
blocks.text: Td₅₀ (Toxic Dose 50) woh dose hai jo dawa lene walon mein se 50% logon mein zehreela asar paida kare.
Maslan 10 TI wali dawa 2 TI wali dawa se kaheen zyada mehfooz hai. ED₅₀ (Effective Dose 50) woh dose hai jo dawa lene walon mein se 50% logon par kaam kare (faida de).

Penicillin ya Paracetamol jaisi dawaiyon ka TI zyada hai. Matlab agar mareez ghalti se dugni (double) dose le le, to bhi us ki jaan ko khatra nahi hota. Doosri taraf Warfarin (blood thinner, khoon patla karne wali dawa) ya Digoxin (heart medicine, dil ki dawa) jaisi dawaiyan bohat ehtiyat se, sirf sahi dose mein leni chahiyein, warna mareez ki jaan khatre mein par sakti hai. Kam TI wali dawaiyan lene walon ko therapeutic drug monitoring (TDM, khoon mein dawa ki miqdar check karte rehna) ke liye ba-qaida blood tests karwane chahiyein.

blocks.title: Khuraak phir bhi ahem hai
blocks.text: Zyada TI ka matlab yeh nahi ke dawa jitni chahein le lein. Maslan Paracetamol ki had se zyada dose liver (jigar) ko sakht nuqsan de sakti hai, is liye batayi gayi dose hi leni chahiye.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Blood-level monitoring (khoon mein dawa ki miqdar napna) ke modern tareeqon se pehle, hospitals mein ghalti se hone wali deaths (mauton) ki aik aam wajah Digoxin thi. Is ka TI itna kam hai ke aam foods (khaanon) ya doosri dawaiyon ke saath maamooli interaction (milne ka asar) bhi mareez ko jaan-leva “toxic zone” (zehreele hisse) mein dhakel deta tha. Is ki toxicity (zehr) ventricular fibrillation (dil ki jaan-leva be-tarteeb dharkan) aur “peela” nazar aana (xanthopsia) paida karti hai.

blocks.prompt: Dawa X ka ED₅₀ 5 mg aur TD₅₀ 100 mg hai. Is ka therapeutic index nikalein.
blocks.explanation: TI = TD₅₀ / ED₅₀ = 100 / 5 = 20. Yeh nisbatan mehfooz dawa hai.

items: TI = TD₅₀ / ED₅₀; zyada TI = zyada mehfooz dawa.
Td₅₀: 50% logon mein zehreela asar; ED₅₀: 50% logon par faida.
Zyada TI: Penicillin, Paracetamol; kam TI: Warfarin, Digoxin (TDM zaroori).
Kitab ki Figure 32.1 ka formula ulta chhapa hai; sahi TD₅₀/ED₅₀.
